_doc: Figures the `figures` / `why <name>` inspector explains. Each reads the running game through state paths: dotted names of Sim attributes or methods (a method is called with no arguments; a name after a dict looks up its key). value: the path of the number. components, flows, drivers: a path to a mapping of name to number, or {name: path}. label, unit and digits describe it. A mod adds figures in mods/<mod_id>/data/ui/figures.json under ids <mod_id>:<name>. A figure that needs code (a cause book, a loop) is registered with @figure in sim/ui instead.

price_index.label: price level against the starting one
